entrance.name: Supermarket Entrance
entrance.description: The main entrance with shopping carts. Tension is high as senior citizens stretch their calves.

health_aisle.name: Health & Pharmacy Aisle
health_aisle.description: The epicenter of today's special offers. A crowd of octogenarians clusters in front of the shelves.

fresh_section.name: Meat & Deli Counter
fresh_section.description: It smells like cured meats and nostalgia.

gold_denture.name: Solid Gold Denture
gold_denture.description: A premium set of false teeth, perfect for chewing tough meat.

suppository_box.name: Discounted Suppository Box
suppository_box.description: The very last pack on the shelf. Everyone is fighting for it.

coin_bag.name: Bag of Small Coins
coin_bag.description: A heavy bag filled with thousands of tiny copper coins.

granny_jeanine.name: Granny Jeanine
granny_jeanine.description: An elderly lady in a hurry who pays exclusively in 1-cent coins.
dialogue: If you want that denture, you'll need to bring me thousands of coins!

grandpa_gaston.name: Grandpa Gaston
grandpa_gaston.description: A veteran sprinter ready to do anything to snag the best discounts.
dialogue: First come, first served on the diapers and suppositories!

buy_denture.description: Buy the gold denture using thousands of small coins.

run_for_suppos.description: Sprint to the health aisle to grab the suppository box before Grandpa Gaston.
